title: Not to the Terrors of the Lord
description: Not to the Terrors of the Lord in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 6 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book II, composed on divine subjects, hymn 152, headed “Sinai and Sion, Heb. 12. 18 &c”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Common Metre (8.6.8.6). This page sets the words to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Not to the ter-rors of the Lord, The tem-pest, fire, and smoke, Not to the thun-der of that word Which God on Si-nai spoke;

lines: Not to the terrors of the Lord,
Not to the thunder of that word
But we are come to Sion's hill,
Where milder words declare his will
Behold the spirits of the just
Whose faith is turn'd to sight!
Whose names are writ in heaven;
And God the judge of all declares
The saints on earth and all the dead
All join in Christ their living head,
The man that dwells where Jesus is,

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
